Messages.Body:
Hi! Here are eight difficult questions in Jyhad game. If somebody know the
answers, please help. 1- Can I play two or more of the same combat card in a
single combat (two "Skin of Steel" or two "Flash", for example)? 2- Is the
effect of "Increased Strength" cumulative? 3- May I atack TAPPED vampires as
a D action (like in Haven Uncovered and Bum's Rush)? 4- May I play another
master card if somebody burns my master card with a "Sudden Reversal"? 5- I'm
attempting to bleed +1 with a "Social Charm" action. May I play "Mask of 1000
Faces" to change the acting minion to a minion who doesn't have "Presence"?
6- May I play "Mask of 1000 faces" when a minion is trying to leave torpor,
to change the acting minion to a minion that is not in torpor? 7- What
happens if, in the end of a combat, a minion plays "Cat's Guidance" and the
opposing minion plays "Psiche"? 8- Can the strikes of "Entombment" and "Coma"
be used at long range? Thanks! Rodrigo Russano

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 21 Sep 1998 rodrigo...@hotmail.com wrote:

> Hi! Here are eight difficult questions in Jyhad game. If somebody know the
> answers, please help. 1- Can I play two or more of the same combat card in a
> single combat (two "Skin of Steel" or two "Flash", for example)?

Yes

> 2- Is the
> effect of "Increased Strength" cumulative?

Yes.

3- May I atack TAPPED vampires as
> a D action (like in Haven Uncovered and Bum's Rush)?

Of course. Why not?

A successful "enter combat" action has nothing to do with the victem being
tapped or untapped. If he was untapped before you attack him, he does not
tap when you enter combat with him (unless, of course, he successfully
blocks your enter combat action.)

> 4- May I play another
> master card if somebody burns my master card with a "Sudden Reversal"?

No.

> 5- I'm
> attempting to bleed +1 with a "Social Charm" action. May I play "Mask of 1000
> Faces" to change the acting minion to a minion who doesn't have "Presence"?

No....at least, not since the 6/23 rulings.

> 6- May I play "Mask of 1000 faces" when a minion is trying to leave torpor,
> to change the acting minion to a minion that is not in torpor?

No. A vampire cannot mask any action that he could not have taken
himself. Vampires who are not in torpor cannot take leave-torpor actions.

> 7- What
> happens if, in the end of a combat, a minion plays "Cat's Guidance" and the
> opposing minion plays "Psiche"?

Umm, exactly what the cards stay they do. Cat's Guidance untaps the
blocker, then Psyche (played by either minion) causes a new combat to
begin.

...and the blocker remains untapped. Entering combat never does anything
to tap/untap minions. Taking actions taps you, and successfully blocking
taps you. Since combat normally results from successfully blocking an
action, both minions are normally tapped.

But it is perfectly possible for both minions to be untapped. Example: I
successfully bum's rush an untapped minion, play superior Majesty as my
strike (untapping the attacker), then Psyche is played by either minion.

> 8- Can the strikes of "Entombment" and "Coma"
> be used at long range?

Only if card text indicates that they can, as with the word "ranged". I
do not have the card text in front of me, but I assume the answer is "no",
or else you would not be asking.

Lupus Australis

Messages.Author: mboh...@shout.net
Messages.Body:
In article <6u6jni$vh2$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,

rodrigo...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Hi! Here are eight difficult questions in Jyhad game. If somebody know the
> answers, please help.

I'll give you the short answers.

> 1- Can I play two or more of the same combat card in a
> single combat (two "Skin of Steel" or two "Flash", for example)?

Yes. The only limit on playing multiple copies of a given card is by
card text or in the case of action/reaction modifiers.

> 2- Is the effect of "Increased Strength" cumulative?

Yes.

> 3- May I atack TAPPED vampires as a D action (like in Haven Uncovered and
> Bum's Rush)?

Yes. You'll note that Ambush only allows you to attack tapped vampires.

> 4- May I play another master card if somebody burns my master card with a
> "Sudden Reversal"?

No, as it is still counted that you played a master card.

> 5- I'm attempting to bleed +1 with a "Social Charm" action. May I play "Mask
> of 1000 Faces" to change the acting minion to a minion who doesn't have
> "Presence"?

No, according to the newest rulings. You may wish to check out the RuleMonger
web site:

http://www.shout.net/mbohlman/rulemirror/rulemonger

> 6- May I play "Mask of 1000 faces" when a minion is trying to leave torpor,
> to change the acting minion to a minion that is not in torpor?

No, according to the newer rulings. You may not Mask an action that the
Masking vampire is incapable of taking. The Masking vampire in this case
cannot attempt a leave torpor action because it is not in torpor.

> 7- What
> happens if, in the end of a combat, a minion plays "Cat's Guidance" and the
> opposing minion plays "Psiche"?

A new combat begins, and the minion playing Cat's Guidance will be
untapped. Just being in combat does not tap you.

> 8- Can the strikes of "Entombment" and "Coma"

> be used at long range? Thanks! Rodrigo Russano

No. Only strikes that do XR damage or specifically state usable at range
have _an effect_ at long range. You can always play Entombment or Coma
at long range, but it won't do anything because they are not ranged
strikes.

Mike

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <6u6jni$vh2$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,
rodrigo...@hotmail.com writes

>Hi! Here are eight difficult questions in Jyhad game. If somebody know the
>answers, please help.

>1- Can I play two or more of the same combat card in a
>single combat (two "Skin of Steel" or two "Flash", for example)?

Yes, unless the card says otherwise or the rules do.

You can't play two Flashes one after the other to keep the range the
same.. however, you could play a flash, have your opponent maneuver and
then you play flash... but you can't cancel your own maneuvers.

Also, with Skin of Steel, you can only prevent damage if there is damage
to prevent, so you can't just play two to get rid of them on the same
strike - btu you could play them in different rounds or on different
strikes.

>2- Is the
>effect of "Increased Strength" cumulative?

Yes. The + symbol is used in Jyhad to indicate cumulativeness of the
figures.

>3- May I atack TAPPED vampires as
>a D action (like in Haven Uncovered and Bum's Rush)?

Yes, assuming you use the cards named to do so. They simply say "Enter
combat with a minion". They do not ask that the minion be untapped or
tapped. Ambush, of course, requires the minion to be tapped.

>4- May I play another
>master card if somebody burns my master card with a "Sudden Reversal"?

No. Playing your master card uses your 1 master phase action per turn.
Suddenly reversing it doesn't give you that action back, it just
prevents the card from doing what it should. You would need the
Parthenon, Anson or Rumors of Gehenna to play another master card after
a Sudden Reversal.

>5- I'm
>attempting to bleed +1 with a "Social Charm" action. May I play "Mask of 1000
>Faces" to change the acting minion to a minion who doesn't have "Presence"?

No. Mask of 1000 Faces has errata to state that an action can only be
taken over by a minion if he would have been legally able to be the
acting minion given all the cards currently in use on the action -
including action modifiers.

>6- May I play "Mask of 1000 faces" when a minion is trying to leave torpor,
>to change the acting minion to a minion that is not in torpor?

No, as above, I believe. I cannot mask Wynn's rush action because I
could not have started the action unless I was Wynn. Similarly, I could
have left torpor if I wasn't in torpor so I doubt I could take the
action over.

>7- What
>happens if, in the end of a combat, a minion plays "Cat's Guidance" and the
>opposing minion plays "Psiche"?

Cat's Guidance - untaps the vampire. Psyche - re-enters combat. What
conflict do you see here?

>8- Can the strikes of "Entombment" and "Coma"
>be used at long range?

No. for a strike to be usable at long range, it has to say so (see
theft of vitae and compare with the Serpentis steal blood card which
does not allow itself to be used at range) or be ranged damage (which is
just another way of stating "may be used at long range, really").
